headline: I make useful things feel like magic.
intro: Hey, I’m Cauz. I build websites, playful tools, and systems that make a little more room for good ideas.
about: I like figuring things out by building them. Some days that means a web app, other days it means debugging a network, wiring up an IoT device, or trying to make a board do exactly what I told it to do. I’m a computer science student with hands-on experience in networking and IoT. I’m still learning, but I’m very much in the habit of making things real.
now: Currently tinkering with web tools, automation experiments, and anything that makes everyday work feel less repetitive.

services.title: Websites & web apps
services.note: Interfaces that stay light and responsive.

services.title: IoT & embedded
services.note: From a rough idea to a device that actually works on your network.

services.title: Hosting on my own lab
services.note: I self-host websites, bots, databases and game servers, monitored 24/7 with daily backups. Happy to run yours too.

process.title: Tell me what you need
process.copy: A few lines in the form below is plenty: the problem, who it is for, and any deadline.

process.title: We talk it through
process.copy: I reply by email, and if it helps we set up a short call to pin down scope.

process.title: I build it
process.copy: Find the real friction, then turn it into something people genuinely enjoy using.
